packageRules.description: This repo dogfoods couch-kit: track every @couch-kit package in one PR and auto-merge non-major updates once CI (including the APK check) passes.

Android native stack: Nitro, Expo, React Native and native modules. Grouped so the APK check runs once per batch; never auto-merged, because native ABI drift (nitro-http-server vs nitro-modules, July 2026) does not show up in typecheck or unit tests.

react-native-nitro-http-server 1.9.x (via @couch-kit/host) declares peer react-native-nitro-modules ^0.35, and Nitro minors change the generated C++ ABI, so hold nitro-modules within 0.35 until http-server moves.
Web toolchain and test runner: open PRs, review manually.
Expo CLI's Metro server needs the TypeScript 5 compiler API (TS 7 fails with 'reading getCurrentDirectory'), so the TV host stays on TS 5 while the rest of the monorepo moves on.
React Native's Android build targets JDK 17; JDK 25 class files (major version 69) break Gradle's build script compile.
Peer ranges describe compatibility, not the version we install: widen them instead of raising the floor.
